newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Verbund 9-mnth pre-tax profit up 7.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Verbund 9-mnth pre-tax profit up 7.4 pct.

text.p: Austria's national grid company, Oesterreichische Elektrizitaetswirtschafts AG (Verbund) said on Friday 9-month pre-tax profit rose 7.4 percent to 872.7 million.
In a statement the firm said cost cutting measures should help it match its 1995 result for the full year.
In 1995 Verbund reported a pre-tax profit of 1.4 billion schillings.

"The electricity business...in the first three quarters was characterised by an increase in sales revenues, continued strict cost management, and river water levels that were considerably below (normal)," Verbund said.

It said sales rose 4.9 percent to 14.7 billion schillings, while operating income fell 22.8 percent to 2.369 billion. It traced the decline to higher fuel and electricity costs due to low water levels which affected hydropower production.
